D: The Spengler family moves into the old firehouse just as an ancient ghost threatens to freeze New York.
P: Serve dessert when the mini-Pufts turn up causing chaos.
S: Phoebe's off the team for being underage. Thin crust pepperoni pizza, mozzarella
Pizza dough topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked at 250C for 10 minutes and cut into squares, eaten straight from the tray.
Melody the chess ghost can't eat them. Cocktail sausages in puff pastry

Cocktail sausages wrapped in buttery puff pastry with sesame, baked until golden and lined up like chess pieces, with tomato sauce and mustard. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 24 strips and wrap one around each of 24 cocktail sausages, seam underneath. Lay on a lined tray, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden. Line them up on a board in rows and serve with tomato sauce and American mustard.
M: Corned beef, sauerkraut and Swiss cheese on buttered rye, with dressing
Rye bread layered with sliced corned beef, sauerkraut, Swiss cheese and Russian dressing, grilled in butter until melting.
Hot soup for Garraka's deep freeze

Chicken noodle soup simmered with carrot, celery and dill, served piping hot with crusty bread. Put 800g chicken thighs in a pot with 2L chicken stock, 1 onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks, all diced, plus 2 bay leaves. Simmer 30 minutes, then lift out the chicken and shred it. Add 150g egg noodles and cook 6 minutes. Return the chicken, season well and stir in a handful of chopped dill and the juice of half a lemon. Serve piping hot with buttered crusty bread.
W: Toasted marshmallow and dark chocolate sandwiched between sweet biscuits
Marshmallows toasted over a flame until golden, squashed with a square of dark chocolate between two plain sweet biscuits.
Ray's occult shop brown butter shortbread
butter cooked till nutty, creamed with sugar and flour, pressed into a scored round, baked pale

Butter, sugar and flour shortbread pressed into a round, scored and baked at 160C until pale golden. Melt 250g butter in a pan and cook until it smells nutty and turns golden brown, then chill until firm but soft. Beat with 110g caster sugar until pale. Mix in 330g plain flour, 30g cornflour and a pinch of salt. Press into a lined 23cm round tin, mark into 12 wedges and prick with a fork. Bake at 160C for 35 to 40 minutes until pale golden. Sprinkle with caster sugar and cut along the lines while warm.
K: Lime cordial and soda over crushed ice with a scoop of lime sorbet
Bright green lime cordial and soda over crushed ice with a scoop of lime sorbet slowly melting in.
